description: Smart-search filters for the Rate Exceptions tab ONLY. One config file per tab, because oj-sp-smart-search renders a chip for EVERY filter the loaded config declares — suggestion-filters does NOT gate that row. Each `field` IS the endpoint's literal query-param name (see reportCriterion.ENDPOINT_PARAMS); a field that is not a real param yields a chip that filters nothing, because the views ignore unknown params silently. This set is deliberately CURATED, not exhaustive — the endpoint accepts more params than are offered. Equipment Name re-added by request for chip-set parity with the other report tabs (was previously covered by q= alone). Project was ALSO added for the same reason but then removed: this view's rows have no project field at all (unit/class/subclass-level data), so the chip could never be anything but empty.
